fig_main_dumbbell.pdf.transformation: Per-category point estimates on a common row; hollow PatchCore squares retain visible ties; no rescaling of metric values.
fig_main_dumbbell.pdf.uncertainty: Single-seed estimates; no between-run uncertainty is available.

fig_regionsize.pdf.selection_rule: All regions; prescribed bins ordered as in pooled CSV
fig_regionsize.pdf.transformation: Exact region_detected/n per method and bin; 95% Wilson score intervals, z=1.959964; horizontal dodge ±0.12; lines are ordinal guides only.
fig_regionsize.pdf.uncertainty: Nominal region-level Wilson intervals; regions within an image may be dependent (not an image-cluster interval).

fig_tradeoff.pdf.selection_rule: Prescribed nine model/control variants; no post-processing points; z-mean ≈ mean, so only pyramid mean is drawn.
fig_tradeoff.pdf.transformation: Six-category arithmetic means, identical to bn* macros; model variants only; log2 latency; baseline reference lines; out-of-range L2+3+4 AU-PRO explicitly marked on the lower spine.
fig_tradeoff.pdf.uncertainty: Single-seed category means; no repeated-run uncertainty available.
